title: Belief file mock proves register resolve furnish
description: Build the file-backed Belief Nexus proof of concept from the landed v1 vision. Sources are typed module files under a declared directory boundary; generation writes a workspace bundle and skills without damaging an existing workspace on malformed input or refusal.
design: Implement typed Register, Resolve, and Furnish through the translator and daemon boundaries. Require module frontmatter placement SystemPrompt or Skill, preserve source/path ownership, use atomic candidate validation before generation, and emit typed refusal on malformed input. Defer repository watch, refurnish, and perma refresh explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: CLI proves Register, Resolve, and Furnish; malformed frontmatter produces a typed refusal; an invalid candidate leaves the prior generated workspace intact; generated output contains the expected Codex bundle marker and skill consumption path; source and output paths stay within owned boundaries; watch/refurnish/perma refresh are documented as deferred.
